title: An explicit restriction changes applicability while an implicit default preserves it
summary: Distinguish an overt restriction/exception operator from a renderer default that merely omits an argument or state.

design.mechanism: A complete construction explicitly narrows when a following field is licensed; absent that construction, the field remains applicable by default.
design.unit: Matched action/argument envelopes with independently bound applicability status and overt versus omitted restriction cues.
design.contrast: Explicit restriction versus implicit default/omission, with action, carrier and position matched.
design.prediction: The explicit-restriction model predicts selective non-applicability or licensing changes only in marked contexts; implicit-default models predict the same field availability after controlling host and position.
design.falsifier: If independently bound marked and unmarked contexts have identical applicability while only renderer omission varies, explicit restriction fails; a restriction effect that is present without the marker also defeats this constructional claim.
design.scope: Cached state/argument records; independent applicability endpoint availability_unknown.
design.related: Near IDEA000042 conditional applicability and IDEA000043 prohibition, but narrower: explicit licensing polarity versus unmarked default, not generic condition or deontic meaning.
design.countermodel: A missing carrier or inherited state can look like non-applicability while the construction encodes no restriction.

source_evidence.quote:
Damit ist ein Stamm weiterhin nur ein kurzer Wert. Eine längere Form wie
`OT+AIIN` bedeutet nicht, dass AIIN nun „den nächsten Wert als Träger eröffnen“
heißen muss. Sie setzt sich aus `OT=DANACH/ERÖFFNEN` und `AIIN=WERT` zusammen.

design.intake_limit: Raw proposal retained for later method review. Missing independently bound endpoints or identical model predictions are design/capacity stops, not empirical refutations. Source working glosses do not supply semantic gold.
